name: aria-gateway
description: The Aria gateway's OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint. The base URL must include /v1: the adapter only appends /chat/completions to addresses that do not already end with /chat/completions, so requests without the prefix hit the gateway's 405. Credentials appear only as an environment variable name: api_key_env points to AGENTHUB_EXAMPLE_API_KEY on the server process; the real key is neither in this JSON nor in the database.

metadata.env_hint: AGENTHUB_EXAMPLE_API_KEY (environment variable on the server process, see README)
